entities.name: Mpongwe Trade at the Gabon Estuary
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Mpongwe clans control trade at the Gabon Estuary (Libreville area); intermediaries between European ships and interior peoples; accumulate wealth and adopt some European customs.
